summary.scope: Production build served locally (domain not live); 16 pages + 404 crawled; Lighthouse 12.6 mobile on 3 page types; throttled visibility test
summary.business_type: Tour operator / travel agency (local service with destination content)
top_findings: Critical: sensetunisia.com does not resolve, so nothing can be indexed
High: loading screen hides content until every image loads (9.5 s on slow 4G, home); LCP records the loader's own image
High: home page transfers 3.4 MB of images up front because lazy images are forced eager
High: almost no trust signals (no About page, licence, address, hosts, reviews; generated photography)
High: destination pages titled 'Guide' but about 200 words
quick_wins: Fix the turquoise duration badge contrast (3.53:1, needs 4.5:1)
Add 1-2 contextual internal links per page (journeys to /destinations/tunis/, destinations to journeys/experiences)
Rewrite alt text to describe the photos
Add a two-level BreadcrumbList to journeys and destinations

categories.name: Technical SEO
what_works: Self-referencing canonicals on 9 indexable pages; noindex,follow on 7 experiences and 404
robots.txt allows all and lists the sitemap; sitemap = the 9 indexable URLs
CSP, HSTS, X-Frame-Options, nosniff, referrer, permissions and COOP headers
Build fails on bad titles, descriptions, H1 counts or broken internal links

findings.title: Site not live
findings.description: https://sensetunisia.com and https://www.sensetunisia.com do not resolve (31 Oct 2026).
findings.recommendation: Deploy, connect the domain, verify in Search Console and Bing, submit the sitemap.

findings.title: Live server behaviour unverified
findings.description: Local preview cannot show Vercel's 404 status, trailing-slash redirects, headers or the www/apex rule.
findings.recommendation: Check all four after deployment.

findings.title: No www/apex rule in the repo
findings.description: Configured in the Vercel dashboard, not in vercel.json.
findings.recommendation: Make sensetunisia.com primary and redirect www to it.

findings.title: Analytics scripts 404 until enabled
findings.description: Two console errors per page; Best Practices 96.
findings.recommendation: Enable Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights.

categories.name: Content Quality
what_works: Journey pages state duration, inclusions and price per person

findings.title: Almost no trust signals (E-E-A-T)
findings.description: No About page, named hosts, ONTT licence, address, reviews or social profiles; photography is generated.
findings.recommendation: About page with people, licence and address; real photos; reviews on Google and Tripadvisor.

findings.title: 'Guide' titles on ~200-word destination pages
findings.description: Searches like 'Sidi Bou Said' or 'Tozeur' are answered by long guide articles.
findings.recommendation: Retitle for planning intent, or put the depth in journal posts that link back.

findings.title: Very thin experience pages
findings.description: 47-62 words; contained by noindex.
findings.recommendation: Keep noindex until each has about 300+ useful words.

findings.title: Journey pages lack buyer essentials
findings.description: No meeting point or pickup, group size, cancellation policy, languages, FAQ or reviews.
findings.recommendation: Add once the facts are confirmed.

categories.name: On-Page SEO
what_works: One H1 per page, logical heading order
Descriptive slugs; complete Open Graph and Twitter tags
Every page one click from home

findings.title: Few links between pages
findings.description: Journeys link only to home and the other journey; five of six destinations link only to home and their neighbours.
findings.recommendation: Add contextual links per SITE-STRUCTURE.md section 4.

findings.title: Odd WhatsApp message for experiences
findings.description: 'Hi Sense, I'm interested in Culinary.'
findings.recommendation: Use 'the Culinary experience' or the subtitle.

categories.name: Schema / Structured Data
what_works: Generated from the same data as the pages

findings.title: Incomplete TravelAgency
findings.description: No street address, locality, logo, sameAs, priceRange or contact hours.
findings.recommendation: Add them once the business details exist.

findings.title: No BreadcrumbList
findings.description: No breadcrumb markup on detail pages.
findings.recommendation: Add Home > page now; Home > section > page once hub pages exist.

findings.title: Loader hides content until every image loads
findings.description: Throttled (1.6 Mbps, 150 ms, 4x CPU): home content visible at 9.5 s, Sahara at 4.3 s; Chrome's LCP records the loader ring (2.4 s / 1.8 s).
findings.recommendation: Lift the loader once the hero image and fonts are ready, or after about 2 s at most.

findings.title: 3.4 MB of images on first load (home)
findings.description: 27 image requests because lazy images are switched to eager; largest are beach-interlude 599 KiB, souk-medina 444 KiB, carthage 326 KiB.
findings.recommendation: Keep native lazy loading below the fold; no change to image quality.

findings.title: Heavy main-thread work on home
findings.description: TBT 360 ms; 2.1 s of style and layout at 4x CPU; 472 DOM elements.
findings.recommendation: Profile the hidden second atlas SVG and the blur and backdrop filters.

findings.title: Lighthouse image-sizing estimate
findings.description: About 1.1 MiB, mostly by design (cover-crop sizing, visually lossless quality).
findings.recommendation: Keep quality; review sizes for tiles and cards at mobile pixel densities.

categories.name: AI Search Readiness
what_works: Structured data names offers and places

findings.title: Weak signals about the business
findings.description: Generic brand name; no profiles, reviews or mentions on other sites; no About page.
findings.recommendation: Create profiles and link them with sameAs; get onto curated 'best tours' lists; use 'Sense Tunisia' consistently.

findings.title: Little to quote for planning questions
findings.description: Short pages; no FAQ on the journeys.
findings.recommendation: Journal posts with direct answers under each heading; a journey FAQ.

findings.title: No llms.txt
findings.description: Optional file listing the key pages.
findings.recommendation: Add a short file; Google ignores it.

categories.name: Images
what_works: Width and height on every image

findings.title: No src on deferred images
findings.description: 10 of 11 images on home and 3 of 4 on each destination keep their URLs in data-src until JavaScript runs.
findings.recommendation: Ship the smallest width as src, or rely on native lazy loading.

findings.title: Alt text doesn't describe the photos
findings.description: Taglines, page titles and 'destination photograph 1'.
findings.recommendation: Add a descriptive alt per image in src/content.js.

findings.title: Generated photography
findings.description: Per README.
findings.recommendation: Replace with real photos, journey pages first.

phases.name: Phase 1: Critical Fixes
items: Deploy and connect sensetunisia.com (www redirects to apex)
Verify 404 status, trailing-slash redirects and headers live
Search Console and Bing verification; submit sitemap
Enable Vercel Web Analytics and Speed Insights

phases.name: Phase 2: High-Impact Improvements
items: Lift the loader once the hero and fonts are ready (your call: design choice)
Stop forcing below-the-fold images to load
About page, licence, address, real photos (needs business info)
Journey essentials and FAQ (needs business facts)

phases.name: Phase 3: Content & Authority
items: Google Business Profile and review collection

phases.name: Phase 4: Monitoring & Iteration
items: Monthly Search Console, Speed Insights and AI-answer checks
Re-audit about four weeks after launch, then quarterly
Build out experience pages, then re-enable indexing
